messages.subject: multipliers in DSM
parts:
Dear everyone,

I'm working on a density surface model of deer. I did a line transect survey of dung pellets so I now have abundance estimates of dung pellets that I want to transform to deer abundance/density with multipliers (production and decay rate). Is there a function in the R package DSM that I can use to apply multipliers? Is there a sample analysis somewhere for DSMs with multipliers?

Thank you.

All the best,
--
Caryl S. Benjamin
TU Munich

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] multipliers in DSM
parts:
Caryl

I think this paper might be just what you are looking for:

Valente, A.M., Marques, T.A., Fonseca, C. et al. A new insight for monitoring ungulates: density surface modelling of roe deer in a Mediterranean habitat. Eur J Wildl Res 62, 577–587 (2016). https://doi.org/10.1007/s10344-016-1030-0

I don't believe the paper has a supplement containing their analysis, but it should provide you with the basics.
